description: Implementation of CategoryDao interface providing database access methods for Category entities, including various queries by name, URL, code, IDs, lineage, depth, parent, and store.

classes.name: CategoryDaoImpl
classes.description: Repository class implementing CategoryDao for database access operations related to Category entities.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories matching a name pattern within a store and language.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a specific search engine URL within a store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a single category by its SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its code within a store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a list of codes within a store and language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Fetches categories by a list of IDs within a store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieve a category by its ID and associated language.

methods.name: getByCode (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieve a category by merchant store code and category code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories with a specific lineage pattern within a store or store code.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth within a store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists child categories of a given parent category, filtered by store and language.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories in a store with optional parent category filtering.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories in a store.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts the number of products per category within a store given a list of category IDs.

methods.name: listByStore (overloaded)
methods.description: Lists categories in a store filtered by language.
